remarks: You will love this beautiful move-in-ready property, minutes from Ventura beaches and within walking distance to Ventura Harbor and shops, restaurants, etc. Home has all new flooring throughout, as well as professionally painted throughout. Primary bedroom suite features full bath and spacious walk-in closet. Secondary bedroom is across from guest bathroom and the den/office is set up for your convenience, with shelving and space for your computer. Senior community features clubhouse, new fully-equipped fitness center, billiard room, on-going games such as Mahjong, Poker, etc. plus various activities such as plays, catered events, Christmas and New Year's Eve celebrations and much more.
